race.comment: HOULIHAN (3) is a speedy type who was awkwardly away last time and was caught in no mans land so uncharacteristically went back instead of forward. Finished fifth and jockey quizzed on the tactics. Better than that and gets chance to atone. Expect she will be stoked up early and take catching. PARTY DAY (6) is a progressive type who goes well here and has placed 2/3 course and distance. Weighted to feature fresh. GEEGEESCHASER (8) resumed from a long break with an eye-catching second in the same race as HOULIHAN. Fitter and sure to run well again. THERMAL MISS (5) was solid fresh over 1200m then dropped back to this course and distance last time and was off the mark with a maiden win. Fitter and can go on with it. JUST PLAIN NUTS (1) can improve sharply.
